rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with the provided 3AA label and standard blastocyst features, but it likely overstates image-specific certainty (e.g., exact clock-face ICM location, visible nuclei, no degeneration) and incorrectly calls 3AA the highest grade.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, BMI, first cycle status, sperm motility, and endometrial thickness well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat speculative.

Overall logic is clear and structured, and the implantation estimate follows from the factors discussed, but there are minor overreaches and unsupported adjustments (e.g., sperm-related penalty, endometrial and diet/stress effects).

Core recommendations such as proceeding with single embryo transfer are guideline-concordant, but several suggestions are not standard evidence-based routine care (ERA after one failure, embryo glue, aspirin, sildenafil/pentoxifylline, thrombophilia/autoimmune screening).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET and evaluation of hydrosalpinx, though some proposed interventions are more speculative than standard.
